Below are illustrated the power analysis results. Each table describes the number of plots required to detect a 1, 5 or 10% change in each of the response variables, with 60 or 80% power. Analyses have been conducted at the 1:5000 and 1:20 000 resolution, and for the 1 x 1 m quadrat analyses as well as the 250 m\^2 circle.
